card.name: Numbers of weeks before study durations
card.fires_on: The digit or space just before a number of weeks or months in a study duration, such as the 5 in 56 weeks or the space before 48 weeks. It appears in clinical trial follow-up and treatment-length phrases.

modes.label: Digit inside week number
modes.description: The first digit of a two-digit week number, like 52 or 56, after 'week' or 'and'.
